rating: 4.9 from 173 Google reviews (Wanderlog); ThreeBestRated score 4.8, inspection points 116/120
review_themes: Handmade, oven-cooked vegetarian and vegan food — nothing reheated or generic
A warm, friendly host (Katrina) who recommends dishes and looks after guests personally
A hidden gem in Bowral that visitors return to and recommend
Most dishes can be made vegan; careful, coeliac-aware gluten-free preparation
Generous, tasty portions — nacho bowl and polenta chips named again and again
speciality_notes: Vegetarian and vegan food stall in The Mill Courtyard; local and often home-grown produce; outdoor seating; daily menu on the blackboard out front; gluten-free options.

verbatim_quotes_used.author: Vipul L
verbatim_quotes_used.quote: Great choices, everything handmade, oven cooked. We loved the burger and the nachos, they are highly recommended.

verbatim_quotes_used.author: Varshini V
verbatim_quotes_used.quote: Decided to go here because of the amazing reviews! Well deserved - food was amazing and fresh. Will recommend all the dishes - veggie burger, zucchini fritters, tacos and nachos bowl. The host is so warm and friendly. Hidden gem in Bowral!

verbatim_quotes_used.author: Sam S
verbatim_quotes_used.quote: What a hidden gem in Bowral. A must visit for vegetarian and vegans. Had few dishes and each of them were very delicious. Katrina was such a friendly host.
